about: Java entity texture (26.2 path) to the Bedrock textures that draw it with the same layout. Evidence is the share of pixels, inside the UV rectangles the Bedrock geometry samples, where the vanilla Java and vanilla Bedrock textures agree.
about_model_texture_pairs: Bedrock texture to the Java texture that fills it when a converted entity model draws it; the model carries its own UV layout, so these pairs need the same texture role, not the same layout.
